modules.title: Care continuity & result closure panel
modules.clinicalDecisionSupported: Review and closed-loop sign-off of pending supportive diagnostic results before encounter closure
modules.verifiedInputsRequired: Clinician ID, Encounter ID, Diagnostic Order ID, Lab Result Flag
modules.observableResultProduced: Result closure panel with mandatory clinician signature and audit trail
modules.workflowImpact: Prevents diagnostic results from being orphaned or filed without explicit clinical review
modules.safetyRisks: False sense of closure if proxy ID is used; mitigated by strict RBAC and cryptographic audit digest
modules.blockersToClinicalDeployment: Requires live hospital EHR HL7/FHIR diagnostic order connector in production
modules.nextExperiment: Paired-difference time-to-result-acknowledgement study vs legacy manual in-tray

modules.title: Live patient encounter state in CareContinuityPanel
modules.clinicalDecisionSupported: Real-time reconciliation of supportive results with active encounter plan
modules.verifiedInputsRequired: Live encounter object, Patient ID, Signed care plan
modules.observableResultProduced: Dynamically updated care continuity state with pending action indicators
modules.workflowImpact: Eliminates tab-switching between order entries and clinical notes
modules.safetyRisks: Information overload during consultation; mitigated by progressive disclosure
modules.blockersToClinicalDeployment: Sub-second real-time websocket latency verification in low-bandwidth rural clinics
modules.nextExperiment: Usability trial measuring documentation time saved across 50 outpatient encounters

modules.title: Patient anatomical context bridge in VisitOS
modules.clinicalDecisionSupported: Spatial localization of symptoms, findings, and surgical incisions onto anatomical digital twin
modules.verifiedInputsRequired: Patient gender/age baseline, ICD-10 anatomical coordinate mapping
modules.observableResultProduced: 3D/2D anatomical spatial context container synchronized with encounter diagnosis
modules.workflowImpact: Improves patient comprehension and clinician anatomical documentation precision
modules.safetyRisks: Misinterpretation of generic anatomical proxy as patient-specific radiologic rendering
modules.blockersToClinicalDeployment: Explicit patient-facing disclosure distinguishing anatomical reference from MRI/CT scans
modules.nextExperiment: Patient spatial comprehension questionnaire before and after anatomical consultation

modules.title: Live encounter One OS Care Proof
modules.clinicalDecisionSupported: Verification of clinical record completeness, provenance integrity, and legal defensibility
modules.verifiedInputsRequired: Encounter actor IDs, timestamped action logs, signature hashes
modules.observableResultProduced: One OS Proof card with audit digest and completeness percentage
modules.workflowImpact: Prevents incomplete charts from being finalized or billed
modules.safetyRisks: Fabricated proof tokens; strictly prevented by fail-closed signature verification
modules.blockersToClinicalDeployment: National digital signature legal compliance certification (e.g. Kominfo/BSrE)
modules.nextExperiment: Audit error escape rate evaluation across 100 simulated contested clinical charts

modules.title: Longitudinal care journey bridge between VisitOS and CareEpisode
modules.clinicalSetting: Outpatient Care Coordination & Chronic Disease Follow-up
modules.clinicalDecisionSupported: Seamless promotion of single encounter into an ongoing multi-stage care episode
modules.verifiedInputsRequired: Verified Encounter ID, Care Plan, Episode ID
modules.observableResultProduced: Bi-directional navigation and synchronized stage tracking
modules.workflowImpact: Prevents acute visits from ending without scheduled chronic disease follow-up
modules.safetyRisks: Duplicate episode creation; mitigated by idempotent episode seeding
modules.blockersToClinicalDeployment: Multi-provider role-based handoff policies
modules.nextExperiment: Prospective 30-day care plan follow-through tracking in outpatient diabetes cohort

modules.title: Clinical encounter diagnosis seeding and ICD-10 provenance linkage
modules.clinicalDecisionSupported: Exact ICD-10 diagnostic coding linked to verified encounter evidence
modules.verifiedInputsRequired: Clinician diagnosis text, verified plan, standard ICD-10 catalog
modules.observableResultProduced: Immutable ICD-10 diagnosis record with author provenance badge
modules.workflowImpact: Automates accurate billing and cross-facility epidemiological reporting
modules.safetyRisks: Inaccurate auto-coding; mitigated by requiring mandatory physician approval before save
modules.blockersToClinicalDeployment: Integration with national ICD-10 claim reimbursement portal
modules.nextExperiment: Coding concordance trial: PanaceaMed assisted coding vs professional certified coders

modules.title: Active Care Journey Continuity Projection
modules.clinicalDecisionSupported: Prioritizing outreach to patients with active, blocked, or overdue care stages
modules.verifiedInputsRequired: All active patient care episodes and stage timestamps
modules.observableResultProduced: Aggregated journey dashboard with active, blocked, and completed counters
modules.workflowImpact: Enables proactive population health monitoring rather than reactive crisis response
modules.safetyRisks: Missing at-risk patients due to stale timestamps; mitigated by deterministic staleness checks
modules.blockersToClinicalDeployment: Workflow training for clinical nurse coordinators
modules.nextExperiment: Coordinator time-to-intervention comparison across 100 complex multi-morbidity cases

modules.title: Care journey integration in Planning OS
modules.clinicalDecisionSupported: Aligning long-term clinical trajectory with immediate prescription and order items
modules.verifiedInputsRequired: Active care plan, proposed interventions, historical trajectory
modules.observableResultProduced: Trajectory card in Planning OS showing projected milestones
modules.workflowImpact: Prevents fragmented care plans that contradict overarching patient care goals
modules.safetyRisks: Over-reliance on projected trajectory without clinical reassessment
modules.blockersToClinicalDeployment: Clinical guideline alignment review for major specialty societies
modules.nextExperiment: Clinician plan adherence measurement with vs without trajectory visualizer

modules.title: Real-time stall detection & health classification
modules.clinicalDecisionSupported: Immediate identification of patient episodes exceeding expected stage duration windows
modules.verifiedInputsRequired: Stage entry timestamps, STAGE_EXPECTED_DAYS threshold parameters
modules.observableResultProduced: Automated health classification (active, stalled, blocked) and alert badge
modules.workflowImpact: Drastically reduces care abandonment and patient lost-to-follow-up rates
modules.safetyRisks: Alert fatigue if expected day windows are set too tight; customizable overrides implemented
modules.blockersToClinicalDeployment: Empirical calibration of STAGE_EXPECTED_DAYS per disease category
modules.nextExperiment: Prospective measurement of reduction in 60-day lost-to-follow-up rate

modules.title: Longitudinal care plan milestones & action item sync
modules.clinicalDecisionSupported: Tracking specific actionable tasks (e.g. repeat HbA1c at 3 months, nephrology consult)
modules.verifiedInputsRequired: CarePlanMilestone objects, target stages, verification signatures
modules.observableResultProduced: Shared milestone checklist synchronized between clinician in-tray and patient portal
modules.workflowImpact: Ensures patients know exactly what to do next and clinicians see what remains outstanding
modules.safetyRisks: Unclear responsibility assignment; mitigated by explicit owner role attribution
modules.blockersToClinicalDeployment: SMS/WhatsApp notification webhook integration for patient milestone reminders
modules.nextExperiment: Milestone completion rate comparison between standard discharge papers and PanaceaMed sync

modules.title: Clinical order fulfillment & result ingestion into milestones
modules.clinicalDecisionSupported: Automatic fulfillment of care plan diagnostic milestones when lab result is signed
modules.verifiedInputsRequired: SupportiveResult object, matching milestone ID or diagnostic category
modules.observableResultProduced: Automated milestone status update from pending to fulfilled with linked result evidence
modules.workflowImpact: Closes the loop between lab result generation and clinician review automatically
modules.safetyRisks: Erroneous result matching; prevented by strict accession/order ID matching rules
modules.blockersToClinicalDeployment: Direct LIS (Laboratory Information System) HL7 ORU_R01 integration fixture
modules.nextExperiment: Time-to-milestone-reconciliation measurement across 500 automated lab ingestions

modules.title: Care episode stalled stage escalation & auto-routing
modules.clinicalDecisionSupported: Routing stalled or blocked care episodes to designated clinician or coordinator in-tray
modules.verifiedInputsRequired: Escalation trigger condition, destination queue, priority level
modules.observableResultProduced: CareJourneyEscalation records with direct routing action items
modules.workflowImpact: Provides a safety net ensuring no patient falls through operational cracks
modules.safetyRisks: Escalation to wrong department; mitigated by strict escalation role targeting
modules.blockersToClinicalDeployment: Staffing escalation policy SLA approval by clinic management
modules.nextExperiment: Mean time to bottleneck resolution before and after auto-routing activation

modules.title: Clinical encounter outcome closure & episode completion bridge
modules.clinicalDecisionSupported: Formal verification of clinical resolution or defined maintenance transition
modules.verifiedInputsRequired: Clinician ID, outcome classification (resolved, chronic_managed, transferred), summary
modules.observableResultProduced: Signed ClinicalOutcomeRecord that unlocks episode completion state
modules.workflowImpact: Enforces meaningful clinical outcome verification rather than administrative abandonment
modules.safetyRisks: Premature closure without resolving active issues; fail-closed check enforces all stages complete
modules.blockersToClinicalDeployment: Standardized outcome criteria definitions for chronic disease subspecialties
modules.nextExperiment: Audit of closed episodes to verify alignment between recorded outcome and medical records

modules.title: Longitudinal care journey timeline & event provenance audit trail
modules.clinicalDecisionSupported: Reconstructing the complete chronology and actor provenance of every clinical action
modules.verifiedInputsRequired: Timestamped event payloads, actor IDs, cryptographic event digests
modules.observableResultProduced: Tamper-evident linear timeline of all diagnoses, orders, results, and notes
modules.workflowImpact: Ensures absolute medico-legal defensibility and patient history clarity
modules.safetyRisks: Retroactive alteration of clinical history; strictly prevented by append-only event log
modules.blockersToClinicalDeployment: Immutable ledger or append-only database certification for regulatory audits
modules.nextExperiment: Medico-legal audit simulation assessing time required to extract complete event provenance

modules.title: Multi-episode longitudinal patient timeline & cross-journey comorbidity projection
modules.clinicalDecisionSupported: Holistic assessment of disease interactions, contraindications, and polypharmacy
modules.verifiedInputsRequired: All historical patient care episodes, linked comorbidity ICD-10 arrays
modules.observableResultProduced: Cross-journey multimorbidity summary matrix and timeline rollup
modules.workflowImpact: Prevents single-disease tunnel vision in patients with multiple chronic conditions
modules.safetyRisks: Confusing resolved past conditions with active comorbidities; resolved dates tracked
modules.blockersToClinicalDeployment: Integration with national cross-hospital health record exchange
modules.nextExperiment: Detection rate of dangerous drug-disease interactions in multimorbid geriatric patients

modules.title: Vital-sign provenance fail-closed guard
modules.clinicalDecisionSupported: Preventing unmeasured or blank vital signs from being accepted as normal baselines
modules.verifiedInputsRequired: Raw vital sign input string, sensor accession timestamp, nurse ID
modules.observableResultProduced: Fail-closed validation result: rejects unverified or synthetic vital signs
modules.workflowImpact: Stops automated systems from fabricating baseline vitals or assuming zero means normal
modules.safetyRisks: Vital sign fabrication leading to missed hemodynamic shock; 100% prevented by this guard
modules.blockersToClinicalDeployment: None - operational in production codebase and machine-checked in CI
modules.nextExperiment: Continuous real-world ingestion monitoring across 10,000 vital sign transmissions

modules.title: Care journey continuity handoff & FHIR-aligned summary export
modules.clinicalDecisionSupported: Ensuring receiving clinicians receive structured, standardized FHIR-aligned clinical summaries
modules.verifiedInputsRequired: Complete CareEpisode, active problems, current medications, pending milestones
modules.observableResultProduced: FHIR CarePlan/EpisodeOfCare aligned JSON document with cryptographic SHA-256 digest
modules.workflowImpact: Eliminates lost information and duplicated diagnostic tests during inter-facility transfers
modules.safetyRisks: Schema mismatch on receiving EHR; mitigated by strict HL7 FHIR R4 profile alignment
modules.blockersToClinicalDeployment: FHIR interoperability certification with regional health information exchanges
modules.nextExperiment: Receiving physician information retrieval speed test using Panacea FHIR summary vs PDF

modules.title: Total cost of care & financial continuity rollup

modules.observableResultProduced: Cost range estimate with hard "never-deny-care" clinical constraint

modules.safetyRisks: Denial of care based on profitability; strictly blocked by code-level invariant
modules.blockersToClinicalDeployment: Real-time insurance payer pre-authorization API integration
modules.nextExperiment: Patient financial toxicity and treatment adherence study under transparent cost modeling
